info.name: Muse API v1 by useapi.net
info.description:
## [Muse API v1](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1)

Muse API by useapi.net: images and 10-second videos with sound from Meta's Muse agent (muse.ai) on your own Muse accounts. Text to image, image to image from up to 9 images, text / image / video to video with up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio files as inputs. Uploads (raw file or from a URL), the whole Library (media, documents, web apps with public sharing, podcasts), downloads and deletes, jobs, a two-way chat with the Muse agent over SSE with reactions, a live view of the agent's own browser that you can take control of, accounts, account reset and the weekly allowance. Set the `api-token` collection variable (see https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-useapi). POST bodies send JSON (the API accepts JSON or form-data). POST assets sends the file itself as the body. Ids contain `:` and `@`: URL-encode them when you put them in a path variable.

---
**Updated:** October 14, 2026

request.description:
## [Add or update an account](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-accounts)

**Body (JSON).** `email` is required. With `password` the account is added or re-added (signed in once, 30-day session renewed by the API, Muse emails the account a login code on each sign-in). With `email` + `maxJobs` and no `password`, only maxJobs changes.

- `maxJobs`: 1-50, default 10 for a new account.

596 = Meta asks for a security check: sign in once at https://muse.ai in a browser, complete it, then post the same email and password again.

## [List accounts](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-accounts)

Stored records, no call to Muse.
## [Read one account live (plan + weekly usage)](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-accounts-email)

query.description: Optional: pending or all. Default: all.
Optional, decided requests to read, 1 to 100. Default: 50.

request.description:
## [List approvals](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-accounts-email-approvals)

The agent's permission requests on the account: `pending` (each with its `chatId` and `options`; answer with POST chats/{chatId}/approvals/{approvalId}) and `decided`.

## [List permissions](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-accounts-email-permissions)

`defaults` {web, connectors}: auto_allow or always_ask, plus the standing `rules` (allow or deny one website or app action; created by allow_always answers).

## [Change permission defaults](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-accounts-email-permissions)

**Body (JSON).** `web` and/or `connectors`: `auto_allow` (Muse's "Ask for some actions": some actions, like sending an email from a connected Gmail, happen without asking) or `always_ask` (Muse asks first, as an approval in the chat).

## [Change a permission rule](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-accounts-email-permissions-permissionId)

**Body (JSON).** `mode`: one of the rule's `modes` (allow, ask, deny). `ask` removes the rule (asking is the default) and answers `removed: true`. URL-encode the permissionId.

## [Delete a permission rule](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/delete-muse-accounts-email-permissions-permissionId)

Removes the rule. 404 when it is not there. URL-encode the permissionId.

## [Reset a Muse account](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-accounts-email-reset)

**Permanently deletes everything on the account**: every chat, file, document, web app and podcast, the agent's memory and its name. The account gets a fresh agent computer and stays added. **Body (JSON).** `confirm` is required: the account email again. Answers 200 `{email, reset: true, ready: true}`, or 202 with `ready: false` while the new computer starts: do not call it again then. 409 while jobs or chat answers run on the account.
## [Remove an account](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/delete-muse-accounts-email)

header.description: The file's MIME type: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/webm, audio/mpeg, audio/wav, audio/x-wav, audio/mp4, audio/x-m4a or audio/ogg.

query.description: Optional. The account to upload to. Default: a random healthy account with allowance left.

## [Upload an asset](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-assets)

The file is the raw request body (no multipart), 1 to 52,428,800 bytes (50 MB), with Content-Length. To upload from a link instead, see POST assets (url). Returns the assetId used as image_N / video_N / audio_N of a job. The file is written into the account's Muse workspace.

query.description: Optional, podcasts only: cover = the episode's cover image.
Optional, md, txt and html documents only: pdf = the document as a PDF.

request.description:
## [Download an asset](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-assets-assetId)

Streams any Library item from the account's Muse workspace: an image, video or audio file, a document (with `format=pdf` an md, txt or html document as PDF), a web app as one HTML file, or a podcast as MP3 (with `part=cover` its cover). URL-encode the assetId.

query.description: Optional. The account to upload to. Default: a random healthy account with allowance left.

request.description:
## [Upload an asset from a URL](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-assets#upload-from-a-url)

JSON body `{"url": "https://…"}`: a public https URL of the file (up to 2048 chars). The API downloads it and uploads it to the account's Muse workspace. Same supported types and 50 MB limit as a raw upload. Returns the assetId.

query.description: Required when the token has more than one Muse account.
Optional: image, video, audio, document, web, podcast, or any other type the list shows.
Optional, media only: uploaded, generated or made.
Optional, 1 to 100. Default: 50.
Optional, the cursor from the previous page.

request.description:
## [List assets](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-assets)

The account's whole Muse Library as asset ids, newest first: images, videos and audio, documents, web apps (with `shareUrl` while published) and podcasts, each with its `type`. `origin` (media only): `uploaded`, `generated` or `made` (by the agent's own tools). Read on with `cursor` until it is null. `partial: true` means a part of the Library could not be read.

## [Delete an asset](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/delete-muse-assets-assetId)

Deletes a Library item: a media file, a document, a web app or a podcast episode. 404 when it is not there. URL-encode the assetId.

## [Publish a web app](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-assets-assetId-share)

Publishes a web app the agent built (an asset of type `web`) on a public link that anyone can open. Muse reviews the app first (about 15 s) and can refuse with 422 and the issues in `errorDetails`. Answers 200 `{assetId, shareUrl}`. Publishing again republishes the current version.

## [Stop sharing a web app](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/delete-muse-assets-assetId-share)

The public link stops working. The app stays in the Library. Answers 200 `{assetId, shareUrl: null}`.

query.description: Required when the token has more than one Muse account.
Optional. Default: workspace.

## [Write a workspace file](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-files)

The raw request body (any type, up to 50 MB, with Content-Length) is written at `path`, replacing a file already there. Pass the path in a chat's `files` to have the agent work on it (file_1, file_2…).

query.description: Required when the token has more than one Muse account.
Required. A path in the workspace, e.g. workspace/your_files/report.pdf.

## [Delete a workspace file](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/delete-muse-files)

Files only, not folders. 404 when it is not there.

## [Generate an image](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-jobs-image)

**Body (JSON).** `prompt` is required (up to 5000 chars). Optional inputs `image_1`..`image_9`: asset ids, all from the same account; name them in the prompt.

- `email`: account to run on. Default: the account that holds the inputs, else a load-balanced one.
- `async`: `true` answers 201 at once (default `false`: waits up to 100 s for the finished job, then answers 202 with the job still running). `replyUrl`: public https webhook URL, receives one POST of the job record when the job ends, sync or async. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

No model, aspect ratio, resolution or duration parameters: say the aspect ratio in the prompt ("in exactly 16:9 aspect ratio").

## [Generate a video](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-jobs-video)

**Body (JSON).** `prompt` is required (up to 5000 chars). About 10 s at about 720p with sound, quoted lines are spoken. Optional inputs: `image_1`..`image_9`, `video_1`..`video_3`, `audio_1`..`audio_3`, asset ids all from the same account; name them in the prompt.

- `email`: account to run on. Default: the account that holds the inputs, else a load-balanced one.
- `async`: `true` answers 201 at once (default `false`: waits up to 100 s for the finished job, then answers 202 with the job still running). `replyUrl`: public https webhook URL, receives one POST of the job record when the job ends, sync or async. `replyRef`: up to 1024 chars.

No model, aspect ratio, resolution or duration parameters: say the aspect ratio in the prompt ("in exactly 16:9 aspect ratio").

## [List running jobs](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-jobs)

`running` (image and video jobs) and `accounts` {email: {running, maxJobs}}. Chats take no maxJobs slot.

query.description: Optional. Adds the job's chat turn from Muse.

request.description:
## [Retrieve a job](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-jobs-jobid)

URL-encode the jobid. `history=true` adds the job's Muse chat turn, read live, for troubleshooting.

## [Start a chat](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats)

**Body (JSON).** `message` is required (up to 5000 chars). Optional `files`: asset ids (up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio files) and workspace paths of other files from POST files (up to 10), all on one account, named image_1, video_1, audio_1, file_1… in order. Optional `email`: the account to chat on, default the account of the files or a load-balanced one (required with only workspace paths when the token has more than one account).

Answers 201 `{chatId, email, messageId}`. Read the answer with GET chats/{chatId}/stream. Chat does not use maxJobs (jobs only).

query.description: Optional, resume after this event id (same as the Last-Event-ID header).

request.description:
## [Stream a chat](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-chats-chatId-stream)

Server-Sent Events for the whole chat: `data:` lines with JSON events (initialized, message, activity, text, message.done, widget, file, status, approval, approval.resolved, turn.done, error, keepalive, idle, reconnect). Resume with the `Last-Event-ID` header or `after`. About 50 open streams per account (approximate: a closed connection is noticed within about a minute), more answer 429 with Retry-After 60. After `idle` or `reconnect`, reconnect with Last-Event-ID to resume exactly where it left off. See the [Chat Streaming Guide](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/chat-streaming-guide).

query.description: Required when the token has more than one Muse account.

request.description:
## [List open streams](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-chats-streams)

The account's open chat streams, approximate: `count`, `limit` (about 50), and per stream `chatId`, `opened`, `seen` (when the connection last reported in, about every 5 minutes).

## [Send a message](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-messages)

**Body (JSON).** `message` is required (up to 5000 chars), optional `files` (asset ids and workspace paths on the chat's account). Send any time, also while Muse is still answering: it takes the message into the running answer. Answers 202 `{chatId, email, messageId}`.

## [React to a message](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-messages-messageId-reactions)

**Body (JSON).** `emoji` is required, one emoji such as 👍. Sending the same emoji again removes it. Answers 200 `{chatId, messageId, reactions}` with the message's reactions after the change.

## [Cancel an answer](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-cancel)

Stops the running answer. Answers `{chatId, cancelled}`.

## [Answer an approval](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-approvals-approvalId)

**Body (JSON).** `decision` is required: one of the `decision` values in the approval event's `options`, e.g. `allow_once` (this one request), `allow_always` (permanent for that site on the Muse account) or `deny`. Answers 200 `{chatId, approvalId, decision, status}`. 409 when the request is no longer waiting (answered or timed out).

## [Answer a widget](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-widgets-widgetId)

**Body (JSON).** Exactly one of `option` (index into the widget's `options`, from 0) or `text` (your own reply, up to 5000 chars). Only kind `option` widgets can be answered. The answer is sent as your next message: 202 `{chatId, email, messageId}`, the reply streams as usual.

Widget kinds: `option` (quick replies in `options`, the only kind you can answer), `html` (a card the agent wrote, in `html`: show it only in a sandboxed iframe, sandbox="allow-scripts" without allow-same-origin), any other kind (`data` as Muse sends it). Show `fallbackText` when you can't render a kind.

query.description: Required when the token has more than one Muse account.
Optional, 1 to 100. Default: 50.
Optional, the cursor from the previous page.

request.description:
## [List chats](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-chats)

The account's chats, newest first, including the ones jobs create.

query.description: Optional, 1 to 1000. Default: 1000.
Optional, the before value from the previous response.

request.description:
## [Read a chat](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-chats-chatId)

The chat's messages as JSON, files as asset ids. Older messages: pass the response's `before` when `hasMore` is true.

## [Delete a chat](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/delete-muse-chats-chatId)

Deletes the chat on Muse. Its files stay in the account's workspace. Stop the agent's browsers in the chat first. The account's main chat answers 409.

## [Read the agent's browser](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/get-muse-chats-chatId-browser-taskId)

The browser's state now: status, the open page, `controlOwner` (agent or user), `previewAvailable` (it can be watched), `ended`, plus `presented` and the `display` size.

`taskId` is the `taskId` of the chat stream's `browser` event or of `browsers` in GET chats/{chatId}. See the [Live Browser Guide](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/live-browser-guide).

## [Open a live view of the browser](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-browser-taskId-viewer)

**Body (JSON), all optional.** `mode`: `view` (default) or `control`. `ttl`: seconds to open the link, 15 to 300 (default 60). `quality` and `compression`: 0 to 9 (default 6 and 1). `width` 320 to 1920 and `height` 240 to 1080 (default 1280 × 720) for a client that sends no size of its own. Answers 200 `{chatId, taskId, url, expiresAt, mode, viewerId, quality, compression}`: open `url` once, before `expiresAt`. One viewer per account at a time, sessions up to 30 minutes.

`taskId` is the `taskId` of the chat stream's `browser` event or of `browsers` in GET chats/{chatId}. See the [Live Browser Guide](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/live-browser-guide).

## [Revoke live views of the browser](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/delete-muse-chats-chatId-browser-taskId-viewer)

Open viewer sessions end within about 15 seconds, and unused links stop working. Answers 200 `{chatId, taskId, revoked: true}`.

`taskId` is the `taskId` of the chat stream's `browser` event or of `browsers` in GET chats/{chatId}. See the [Live Browser Guide](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/live-browser-guide).

## [Give the browser back](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-browser-taskId-release)

Gives control of the browser back to the agent. Answers 200 `{chatId, taskId, released: true, controlOwner}`, also when the agent already has control.

`taskId` is the `taskId` of the chat stream's `browser` event or of `browsers` in GET chats/{chatId}. See the [Live Browser Guide](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/live-browser-guide).

## [Stop the agent's browser](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/post-muse-chats-chatId-browser-taskId-stop)

Closes the browser for good. A Muse account runs at most 2 browsers at a time: stop one you no longer need, and before deleting its chat. Answers 200 `{chatId, taskId, stopped: true}`, 409 when it is already closed.

`taskId` is the `taskId` of the chat stream's `browser` event or of `browsers` in GET chats/{chatId}. See the [Live Browser Guide](https://useapi.net/docs/api-muse-v1/live-browser-guide).
